notes: bêṯ ʾîšāh carries no preposition in the Hebrew, so the supplied in is placed on the noun whose case-function licenses it under rule 33 rather than left added.
The by of by a bond goes to ʾissār under rule 33 as in vv. 2 and 3, with ʿal unrepresented under rule 40 once her soul is a bare object.
The suffix on ʾîš takes her directly; an English possessive expression carries the possessor's determiner, so no determiner is supplied on the construct.
